description: This file defines a custom logger class 'DeepEvalLogger' for integrating LiteLLM with DeepEval's platform, including methods for logging success and failure events, preparing trace API data, and creating trace objects.

classes.name: DeepEvalLogger
classes.description: A custom logger class that logs LiteLLM traces to DeepEval's platform, handling success and failure events asynchronously and synchronously.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the DeepEvalLogger, setting environment variables and API client.

methods.name: log_success_event
methods.description: Logs a successful event to DeepEval.

methods.name: log_failure_event
methods.description: Logs a failed event to DeepEval.

methods.name: async_log_failure_event
methods.description: Asynchronously logs a failed event to DeepEval.

methods.name: async_log_success_event
methods.description: Asynchronously logs a successful event to DeepEval.

methods.name: _prepare_trace_api
methods.description: Prepares the trace API payload based on event data.

methods.name: _sync_event_handler
methods.description: Handles synchronous event logging to DeepEval.

methods.name: _async_event_handler
methods.description: Handles asynchronous event logging to DeepEval.

methods.name: _create_base_api_span
methods.description: Creates a base span object for tracing.

methods.name: _create_trace_api
methods.description: Creates a trace API object containing span data.
